Hi Bethany — thanks for sending these over and welcome! A couple of quick items so procurement can complete vendor setup and issue a PO: 

1) We need a COI that names Redwood Inference as "additional insured" and lists the following limits: General Liability $1,000,000 per occurrence / $2,000,000 aggregate; Professional Liability/Errors & Omissions $2,000,000.
2) Please include the insurer contact (name, phone, email) and the policy number and effective/expiration dates.
3) For US vendors we usually collect a completed W-9 (PDF). If AtlasEdge is non-US, a VAT/Tax ID equivalent is fine.
4) Attach the final vendor-signed onboarding form (we prefer a filled PDF).

I've attached our quick vendor checklist to make sure nothing slips through: Redwood_Vendor_Onboarding_Checklist.xlsx

Once we have the COI with those elements and a billing contact, procurement will issue the PO. If you need a specific invoice header or any vendor portal instructions, flag them in your reply and Marcus will coordinate the PO/billing setup.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
